situation: My neighbour Mrs. Alvarez watered my plants and fed my cat Pepper for 2 weeks while I was in Portugal. She left a little note saying Pepper slept on her lap. I want to leave a card with some pastéis de nata I brought back.
reply: Dear Mrs. Alvarez, thank you so much for looking after Pepper and the plants for two whole weeks. Your note about Pepper napping on your lap made me laugh, she clearly had a better holiday than I did. These pastéis are from a little bakery in Lisbon I think you'd love. Please let me return the favour whenever you're away. Warmly, Clara
note: One concrete detail she couldn't have guessed you'd mention, and a forward line.

situation: 结婚的时候我大学导师随了2000块红包，还专门从外地赶过来参加婚礼。想给他发条微信好好谢谢。
reply: 陈老师，谢谢您专程从成都赶来参加我们的婚礼，看到您坐在台下的时候我特别感动。您的红包我们打算用来买一台一直想要的咖啡机，以后每天早上都会想起您。等您下次来杭州，我们请您来家里吃饭。
note: 礼金不提数目，说用来做什么；重点谢他这个人和他跑的这一趟。

situation: My old manager Denise wrote me a reference 4 months ago and I got the job. I completely forgot to thank her and I feel awful.
reply: Hi Denise, this is embarrassingly late, but I didn't want it to go unsaid: thank you for the reference in June. I got the role at Harlow and I've just finished my first quarter leading the analytics team. A lot of how I run my team comes from watching you run ours. Coffee next time I'm back in Leeds?
note: One clause of ownership for the lateness, then the thanks. No paragraph of apology.

situation: 先週木曜日、取引先の工場見学で製造部長の山本さんが3時間も案内してくださった。特に検品ラインの説明がわかりやすく、うちの品質基準の見直しに役立ちそう。お礼のメールを送りたい。
reply:
山本部長

先週木曜日の工場見学では、3時間にわたりご案内いただき、誠にありがとうございました。特に検品ラインで目視と画像検査の二段階で確認されている様子は、弊社の品質基準を見直すうえで大変参考になりました。お忙しい中、現場の皆様にもお時間を割いていただき、心より感謝申し上げます。10月中旬に社内での検討結果を改めてご報告いたします。今後ともどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

株式会社ミナト 佐藤健
note: Business thanks in Japanese: formal register, but still one concrete detail (the two-stage inspection) and a forward line with a timeframe.

situation: 父亲上个月去世，他以前厂里的老同事刘叔前后忙了三天，帮着联系殡仪馆、招呼来吊唁的老工友。想给他发条微信正式谢谢。
reply: 刘叔，爸走的那几天家里乱成一团，是您前后跑了三天，联系殡仪馆，又站在门口一位位招呼厂里来送他的老工友。好多叔叔阿姨我都叫不上名字，有您在，我们才没有失礼。爸生前常说您是厂里最靠得住的老哥们，这回我们全家是真切体会到了。等过了这阵，我和妈想请您来家里吃顿便饭。
note: 丧事后的感谢要具体到对方做的事，再带一句逝者对他的评价，最后留一个往后的约定。

situation: A stranger, Tomas, found my wallet on the 14 bus Saturday and drove it over to my flat because my licence had the address. Everything was still in it. He left his number on a note.
reply: Hi Tomas, it's Rachel, whose wallet you rescued from the 14 bus on Saturday. Thank you for driving it all the way over instead of just handing it in. Getting my licence and cards back saved me a week of phone calls, and your note honestly made my day. If you're ever near Fairview, I'd love to buy you a coffee. Either way, thank you.
note: A stranger: say who you are first, name the extra effort he chose, and keep any offer light and optional.

situation: 婆婆给我织了一件大红色的毛衣，织了两个月，颜色和款式我都不太会穿。想发微信谢谢她，但不想假装特别喜欢，不然以后得一直穿给她看。
reply: 妈，毛衣收到了，谢谢您。听建国说您每天晚上看电视的时候一针一针织，织了整整两个月，想到这个我心里特别暖。天凉了您也多注意身体，国庆我们回去看您。
note: 不喜欢的礼物：谢她的心思和付出，不编造对毛衣本身的喜爱，免得以后一直演下去；结尾落在见面上。

situation: My dad spent 9 days on Ward 7 at St. James's after a stroke and is home now. The nurses were incredible, especially Grace on nights, who sat with him when he was frightened. I want to leave a card with a box of chocolates for the whole team.
reply:
To everyone on Ward 7,
Thank you for looking after my dad, Peter Walsh, for the nine days he was with you. You kept him safe, and you also kept him laughing, which he'll tell anyone who listens. A special thank you to Grace, who sat with him at 3am when he was frightened; he still talks about it. He's home now and walking to the end of the road and back every morning. We'll never forget what you did for our family.
With love and thanks,
Claire Walsh and family
note: A card for a team: thank everyone, name the one person and the moment, and give them the update they rarely get, how the patient is doing now.

situation: My friend's brother Omar referred me for a product manager role at Fielding and spent half an hour on the phone prepping me the night before my final round. I didn't get it; they went with an internal candidate. I still want to thank him.
reply: Hi Omar, I wanted to let you know I didn't get the Fielding role; they went with someone internal. I still wanted to thank you properly for the referral, and for the half hour on the phone the night before my final round explaining how the product team works. It's the reason I got as far as I did. If I can ever return the favour, I will, and I'll let you know where I land.
note: Thank the effort, not the outcome. The bad news goes in one plain line so he isn't left wondering, then the specific thing he did.

situation: J'ai passé le week-end chez les parents de mon copain Hugo, Martine et Gérard, à Quimper. C'était la première fois que je les rencontrais. Martine avait fait un kouign-amann maison et Gérard m'a emmenée voir le phare d'Eckmühl samedi matin. Je veux leur envoyer une carte.
reply:
Chère Martine, cher Gérard,
Merci mille fois pour ce week-end à Quimper. Le kouign-amann maison restera dans les annales, et la balade au phare d'Eckmühl samedi matin, dans le vent et avec vos histoires sur la côte, a été mon moment préféré. Merci surtout de m'avoir accueillie si simplement, je me suis tout de suite sentie à l'aise. Hugo et moi serions ravis de vous recevoir à Nantes cet hiver.
Bien amicalement,
Clara
note: Premier séjour chez la belle-famille : une carte manuscrite, un détail précis pour chacun, et une invitation en retour.

situation: Had my second-round interview yesterday for a senior product designer role at Northbeam with Elena Park, their head of design. She walked me through how they ran an accessibility audit on checkout, with screen reader users testing in the room, and was very open about their messy legacy design system. Want to send a thank-you email today.
reply:
Hi Elena,
Thank you for your time yesterday. Hearing how your team ran the accessibility audit on checkout, with screen reader users testing in the room, made the role much more concrete for me, and it's exactly the kind of work I want to be doing. I also appreciated how openly you talked about the legacy design system; it's the part of the job I'd most like to dig into. I'm looking forward to hearing about next steps.
Best,
Jordan Lee
note: A post-interview thank-you works when it names one real detail from the conversation, not a restated cover letter.

situation: My daughter Maisie, 7, was terrified of putting her face in the water. Her swimming teacher, Coach Lena, spent the first three lessons just playing a 'blow bubbles at the fish' game with her on the steps, and last Saturday Maisie swam her first width. Her term ends next week and I want to give Lena a card.
reply:
Dear Lena,
Thank you for the patience you've shown Maisie this term. Those first three lessons of blowing bubbles at the fish on the steps were what made the difference, and on Saturday she swam her first width. She hasn't stopped talking about it since. Thank you for never rushing her. We'll see you next term.
With thanks,
Maisie's mum
note: For a teacher or coach, name the method that worked, not only the result, so they know what they did right.

situation: 我9月中旬做了个小手术，请了两周假。同组的小周主动接了我手上两个客户项目，还每天下班前把进展整理成一页文档发给我，我回来第一天就接上了，客户那边一点没耽误。想在微信上好好谢谢她。
reply: 小周，回来这几天一直想正式跟你说声谢谢。我请假那两周，你把我的两个客户项目都接了过去，每天下班前还整理一页进展发给我，我回来第一天就接上了，客户那边一点没耽误。我知道这些都是在你自己的活之外多出来的，真的辛苦了。以后你休假，你手上的活我来接。
note: 同事之间的感谢：说清她额外做了什么、帮你避免了什么，回报只许自己能兑现的。
